suggestions: I'm grateful for the peaceful stillness right after Fajr that helps me center my intentions for the day.
I'm thankful for finally resolving that elusive race condition bug after hours of deep debugging.
I'm grateful for a smooth, uneventful production deployment with zero critical alerts.
I'm thankful for a comforting cup of teh tarik and warm roti canai during a much-needed break.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of a stable tech job that allows me to support both myself and my family.
I'm thankful for teammates who write thoughtful, constructive code reviews and make collaboration easy.
I'm grateful for the calm reset during Friday prayers to pause and reflect amidst a fast-paced sprint.
I'm thankful for the cool morning rain that made waking up and starting the day feel so peaceful.
I'm grateful for spontaneous late-night mamak sessions with close friends to unwind and laugh.
I'm thankful for the flexibility of working from home and never having to rush my daily prayers.
I'm grateful for a warm home-cooked meal waiting at the end of a long day of screen time.
I'm thankful for catching the train just in time and having a smooth, hassle-free commute.
I'm grateful for the mental clarity to solve complex problems and the opportunity to keep sharpening my technical skills.
I'm thankful for weekends spent catching up on rest and reconnecting with family over good food.
I'm grateful for finding barakah and contentment in the simple, quiet progress of everyday life.
